description: Angular separations between planets at a moment, or between longitudes you supply: the pairs near 0, 60, 90, 120 or 180 degrees (or any angle you choose) with the deviation, approaching or receding; optionally equal and opposite declinations. E.g. {longitudes: {sun: 54.4, moon: 297.4}}. For a moment (computed from DE440) or for longitudes you supply: every pair of bodies at a chosen separation angle, with its deviation from the exact angle, the tolerance applied, and whether the bodies are approaching or receding from it. Option 'declination': pairs with equal or opposite declinations. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.02 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/angles (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local civil date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

longitudes.description: Optional {body: degrees} or {body: {longitude, speed, declination?, declination_speed?}}; when given, no ephemeris is used.

angles.description: Separation angles in degrees, 'all' or a list from [0, 30, 45, 60, 72, 90, 120, 135, 144, 150, 180]. Default: [0, 60, 90, 120, 180].

bodies.description: 'all' or a list from ['sun', 'moon', 'mercury', 'venus', 'mars', 'jupiter', 'saturn', 'uranus', 'neptune', 'pluto', 'lunar_node_true', 'lunar_node_true_descending', 'lunar_node_mean', 'lunar_apogee_mean']. Default: the Sun, the Moon, Mercury..Pluto, the Moon's true ascending node, its descending node and its mean apogee.

declination.description: Also return the declinations and the pairs with equal or opposite declinations.

declination_tolerance.description: Tolerance in degrees for equal / opposite declinations.

sun_moon_tolerance_bonus.description: Extra tolerance in degrees when either body is the Sun or the Moon.

tolerances.description: Tolerance in degrees per angle, e.g. {"90": 6}. Defaults: 0 and 180: 8; 90 and 120: 7; 60: 5; the others: 2.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.
